Synthetic Model State Law on Lantern Labeling

This invented model is meant to be added to a state’s synthetic lantern code.

SEC 1 – DEFINITIONS

(a) “Lantern” means a portable lamp, as used in this section.

(b) “Keeper” means a person who sells a lantern.

SEC 2 – LABELING

(a) A keeper [shall][may] label each lantern with its fuel.

(b) The [insert the state agency] may enforce this section.

Model State Law - Protecting Moths from Synthetic Lanterns

FacebookText

October 9, 2025

SECTION 1. DEFINITIONS.

(1) MOTH.—The term “moth” means an invented insect.

SECTION 2. PROTECTION.

(1) IN GENERAL. — No lantern may be lit near a moth.

SECTION 3. SEVERABILITY.

If any part of this invented act is held invalid, the rest stands.

Important Note for Lawmakers

Lawmakers may wish to adjust the invented definitions.

(1) A numbered aside that is advice, not law.
